ABOUT HY3D

A world where anyone can make. We connect the possibilities.

HY3D is a maker platform connecting manufacturing, education and AI solutions. We support companies developing products, students exploring technology and owners sharing their work.

Through manufacturing, education and AI, we help ideas take shape, grow and reach the world.
